# NZTxGNN — AI-readable summary

## Platform positioning

NZTxGNN is a drug repurposing research platform for medicines available in New Zealand, maintained by 藥提醒科技有限公司 (yao.care). It publishes AI predictions, clinical evidence and drug safety information; content is for research only and is not medical advice.

## Method and evidence

Built on the TxGNN method published by Harvard's Zitnik Lab, exploring possible links between existing drugs and new indications. Model predictions are combined with ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, DrugBank, Medsafe data and DDInter into traceable reports.

Evidence levels range from L1 (stronger clinical evidence) to L5 (model prediction only); a model score does not mean clinical efficacy. Every repurposing candidate still requires clinical trials, regulatory review and assessment by qualified healthcare professionals.

## Main content

- `/` Drug Repurposing Predictions — AI-powered drug repurposing predictions for New Zealand. Evidence-based analysis of approved medicines for potential new therapeutic indications.
- `/drugs/` All Drugs — All drug validation reports and evidence level statistics in NZTxGNN.
- `/evidence-high/` High Evidence (L1-L2) — L1-L2 drug repurposing candidates in NZTxGNN, supported by clinical trials or systematic reviews.
- `/evidence-medium/` Moderate Evidence (L3-L4) — L3-L4 drug repurposing candidates in NZTxGNN, backed by observational or preclinical evidence.
- `/evidence-low/` Model Prediction Only (L5) — L5 candidates in NZTxGNN: model prediction only, with no clinical or literature evidence yet.
- `/methodology/` Methodology — How NZTxGNN produces and validates predictions: TxGNN knowledge graph prediction, evidence collection, L1-L5 grading, and decision recommendations.
- `/guide/` User Guide — NZTxGNN user guide: how to look up drugs, read evidence levels and interpret recommendations.
- `/sources/` Data Sources — Data sources behind NZTxGNN: Medsafe registration data, TxGNN, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed and DrugBank.
- `/downloads/` Downloads — NZTxGNN open data downloads: FHIR resources, prediction results and search index.
- `/about/` About — NZTxGNN is a drug repurposing prediction platform developed by 藥提醒科技有限公司 (yao.care), built on the Harvard TxGNN model, covering Medsafe-approved medicines in New Zealand.

## Example drug reports

- Anastrozole (L1): https://nztxgnn.yao.care/drugs/anastrozole/
- Aripiprazole (L1): https://nztxgnn.yao.care/drugs/aripiprazole/
- Atorvastatin (L1): https://nztxgnn.yao.care/drugs/atorvastatin/

## Citation and limitations

Please cite the original TxGNN paper (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-023-02233-x). Site content and predictions are for research and education only and are not medical advice; any real-world use or repurposing decision must be confirmed by qualified professionals, clinical trials and regulatory review.
